page.overview:
Who is Avatar Brave?

Avatar Brave is an Autobot who appears in the game Transformers: Online. He is a humble and silent giant, and a juggernaut on the field, unable to be harmed. Thankfully, he recognizes his own advantages and uses them to help protect his comrades from danger. Category:Cybertronian
